title: Italian Fried Delicate Fish Bites
description: Crispy fried bites of delicate fish served with a side of tangy marinara sauce. A classic Italian appetizer, perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: Delicate fish (such as cod or sole)

instructions: 1. Cut the delicate fish into bite-sized pieces.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the almond flour, yellow cornmeal, and Russo-Italian seasoning.
3. Dip each fish piece into the flour mixture, coating both sides evenly.
4. Heat the stir-fry oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Fry the fish pieces until golden brown and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
6. Serve the fried fish bites hot with a side of marinara sauce for dipping.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley or basil for a touch of freshness.
